summary: RENN Fund, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting the April 7, 2026 death of Murray Stahl, Co-Founder, Chairman, CEO and CIO of Horizon Kinetics Asset Management LLC, the fund's investment adviser. The Board unanimously appointed Peter Doyle as President, CEO and CFO, and added James Davolos to the portfolio management team. This is an abrupt senior leadership change triggered by the passing of a key figure. The filing provides no financial terms or shareholder vote. No tender or transaction is involved. Watch for potential advisor retention or fund strategy shifts.
